description: Collation hold-out sweep (T-3465): 600 random text pairs, seed 3465, drawn by tools/src/rustsheet_tools/gen/collation_holdout.py from the categories it lists; texts of 1 to 6 characters from 1 to 3 categories, every third pair one edit apart (a substitution within a category, an inserted skipped character or combining mark). Row n: A, B = the texts (UNICHAR formulas), C = A<B, D = B<A, E = A=B. The categories of each row's texts are in t3465-collation-holdout.draws.tsv beside this case.
